text.en:
#3766
OFFICIAL GAZETTE
-
Map of Simuay River, scale 1:10,000, surveyed by. B. Buendia,
General Foreman, E. Madamba, Foreman-Instrumentman, and J.
Reyna, Instrumentman, all of the Office of the District Engineer
of Cotabato, and submitted by District Engineer Marcelino N.
Samson; and Bureau of Public Works Road Map of Cotabato
Province, scale 1:250,000.)
Executive Order No. 219, series of 1949, is hereby
amended accordingly.
Done in the City of Mania, this 15th day of September,
in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty-three,
and of the Independeuce of the Philippines, the eighth.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
MARCIANO ROQUE
Acting Executive Secretary
